name: Buckwheat cake
summary: Buckwheat seeds are crushed to powder, mixed with water, poured into a soft mould, and rolled. Vietnam Plus names the cake and does not add a second method.
origin: The Hà Giang plateau. Vietnam Tourism serves it in buckwheat season and at the November festival.
taste: Vietnam Tourism’s line is that the cake will not be confused with another cake.
howToEat: Eat it as a cake. The festival is typically mid-to-late November in Đồng Văn district. The 2026 civil day is Check on arrival.

Bloom windows disagree: late September white, October into November pink, deep red by the end of December, October to November on the place page and on UNESCO, and October to December on the loop page. All of those stay.
where: On the plateau, in buckwheat season and at the Đồng Văn festival.
seoTitle: Buckwheat cake in Ha Giang — banh tam giac mach
seoDescription: Bánh tam giác mạch is buckwheat crushed, mixed with water, moulded, and rolled. Vietnam Plus names the cake. The November festival day is Check on arrival.
